title: feat(nssex): same-lock x-probe later-tick exist-opposite: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Exist-opposite on the degenerate same-lock seed +e_1/+e_1: still hold/hold. Its Theorem 2 contains the band's own admission of the central problem, that against the opposite-lock run 'the holding readout transfers under this seed, the lists do not' — the verdict is seed-independent while the underlying data is not.
